about: Plain-language summary of what the agent has learned about each person's tastes. Shown and editable under Settings on the calendar. When a person edits their summary, the agent treats every statement in it as correct and keeps it.

aaron.summary:
What I'm working from:
- Big yes: repertory and revival film — noir, Hitchcock, Lynch, character actors, sad and humane stories (you flagged the Kore-eda After Life revival).
- Electronic, experimental and ambient music and DJ nights at artist-run spaces (Junglist Heights, Halloween ATP at Current Space).
- Adventurous jazz in small rooms; DIY electronics and synths; photography and small galleries.
- Less likely: arena pop and tribute acts, kids-only programming, sports, pub crawls.

From your flags (23 Interested, none Not interested yet):
- History and old buildings are your strongest thread: Doors Open, Profs & Pints on haunted houses, the BMI social night, the Art & Industry tour of Clipper Mill.
- Talks and author events are a clear yes (André Carrington's Audiofuturism talk), and books keep coming up.
- Music is your most-flagged category: the Peabody jazz faculty concert and John Berndt's experimental night pushed small-room jazz and local experimental shows up.
- Nature and gardening keep showing up (Filbert Street Garden, Mushroom City); Creative Alliance is a favorite venue.

What changed since Thursday: no new flags, so nothing shifted. With books and talks ranking high, I added the first Baltimore Indie Bookstore Crawl (Nov 27–29) and kept looking for small-room jazz and experimental shows.

stacey.summary: Stacey isn't currently set up as a flagger on the calendar and hasn't flagged anything, so there's nothing learned yet. If she's added back, her flags will fill this in — or write what she likes here.
